The namefiilo

It doesn’t mean anything. It was short, and the handles were cheap.

About

fiilo was a minimalist, contemporary lifestyle brand making environmentally conscious products with 3D printing.

It began in 2015, while I was trying to develop a hydroponics system that screwed into a standard plastic bottle to grow herbs. To speed up prototyping I bought my first 3D printer, and to pay it off I started designing planters for cacti and succulents while the hydroponics system was still in R&D.

Every product was printed in 100% biodegradable PLA, a plastic made from renewable resources like cornstarch. To cut plastic further, I later sourced recycled filament from a social enterprise in India that paid locals to collect plastic. The vision was affordable, well-designed products without a negative effect on the environment. fiilo was acquired in 2016 by an American buyer.
